metadata.task: If the waiting area contains unattended equipment, return it to the storage room; otherwise inspect the reception desk.

plan.goal: Navigate to the Waiting Area, detect for unattended equipment, and either transport it to the Medical Supply Store or inspect the Reception Desk depending on findings.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate from the default spawn location (Reception) to the Waiting Area to assess the environment for unattended equipment.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is located at the Reception desk.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is located at the Waiting Area.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot requires navigation to a specific room. The skill 'navigate_to_room' maps to the generic 'navigate_to_pose' action in Nav2, which is the standard implementation for indoor navigation.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Detect unattended equipment in the Waiting Area.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is located at the Waiting Area.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has identified the presence or absence of unattended equipment in the Waiting Area.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot needs to perceive the environment to find objects. The 'detect_object' skill uses the ROS2 Perception topic '/detections' to publish object bounding boxes and labels.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Transport detected unattended equipment from the Waiting Area to the Medical Supply Store.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Waiting Area holding unattended equipment.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Medical Supply Store having placed the equipment.

grounded_skills.reason: To pick up the object, the robot must use MoveIt2 to plan and execute a grasp trajectory.
Navigation to the destination room is required before placing the object.
To place the object, the robot must use MoveIt2 to plan and execute a placement trajectory.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Reception Desk (either originally or after returning equipment).
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has completed the inspection of the Reception Desk.

grounded_skills.reason: Navigation to the Reception room is required.
Since the robot lacks dedicated visual inspection models, capturing an image from the onboard camera is the best available proxy for 'inspecting' the scene.

constraints: Robot is fixed-base and cannot navigate autonomously; all navigation relies on teleoperation.
Robot has no visual perception (no RGB cameras); object detection and scene understanding rely on simulated or external perception feeds.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: The robot will first navigate to the Waiting Area. Upon detecting unattended equipment, it will pick it up, navigate to the Medical Supply Store, and place it there. If no equipment is detected, it will proceed directly to inspect the Reception Desk.
